deterministic_observable.description: After the agent acts, uploader.py must construct its requests with an Idempotency-Key header while retaining a bounded retry loop. A later deterministic check inspects source text for the header pattern and the attempt bound; no LLM judge.

distractor_context.content: Upload timeouts are tuned per region: ten seconds for local zones, thirty for intercontinental links, with backoff capped at five minutes. Breaches raise pager alerts after three consecutive failures.

expected_counterfactual.D: Design expectation only: behaves like N; timeout tuning does not resolve duplicate-charge risk.
expected_counterfactual.N: Design expectation only: keeps or extends the bare retry loop, following uploader.py.
expected_counterfactual.O: Design expectation only: attaches the idempotency key to every attempt while keeping retries bounded.

latent_state.causal_reason: Once per-request charging is known, a bare retry is not resilience but a double-billing hazard; retries must carry the checkout-issued idempotency key the endpoint deduplicates on.
latent_state.description: The fulfilment endpoint creates a charge for every POST it receives and deduplicates retried submissions only through the idempotency key issued at checkout.
latent_state.required_action: Attach the idempotency key header to every attempt, keeping the bounded retry loop (action B).

oracle_context.content: The fulfilment endpoint creates a charge for every POST it receives. Retried submissions are deduplicated only through the idempotency key issued at checkout, which must accompany every attempt.

task.description: In this repository, harden the order uploader in uploader.py against transient network failures so no order is silently lost. Keep the existing module structure and keep the retry budget bounded.

visible_default.action: Keep or extend the bare retry loop that re-posts on any exception (action A).
visible_default.rationale: uploader.py already retries transient failures with a bounded budget and its test pins the bound; a competent agent extends that visible pattern.
